## Mandatory fixes before feature proliferation
- **Fix #640 Virizion**: v0.1.0 erroneously says unavailable/not in PokeMMO Dex, but Lunar New Year 2026 permanent raids and updated community sources confirm Virizion is currently obtainable via 6-star permanent raid, likely Pinwheel Forest. Review **Cobalion & Terrakion**; validate actual Dex membership and category eligibility separately. Update provenance, tests, visible UI. The old wiki was stale.
- Remove claim that 644 is complete in-game roster or force-fit 604: the user's screenshots and updated forum guide have divergent maximum counters, and `Seen` vs `Owned` denominators differ. Make membership conditional+verified, never deduce '40 absent' purely from subtraction. Keep optional 649 reference view.
- Classify legendary and special species through separate axes: game Dex membership, permanent wild/raid/temporary acquisition, eligibility for Seen/Owned/OT/Alpha/Shiny/Costume, character's manual records. Do not mark 'unavailable' when actually a perma raid.
- Repeat regression after official 2026 patches and compare conflicts with real in-game screenshots. Correct source labels, screenshot dates and test-data boundaries.
- Improve Pokedex card/Detail readability and Compact/Standard/Expanded popout use. Keep unlimited scrolling, saved mode-specific freely resizable geometry.
- Replace A+/A- footer with clear **Text size** icon/popover/slider+reset, keyboard-accessible. Preserve text contrast with transparent game backgrounds.
- Preserve better Home, Quick Access, XY type chart, full article/event views, saved guide checklists, real Alpha/Swarm read-only feed, and honest Test notifications. Improve only actual usability pain.
- An extremely large white Reshiram was visible at PokeMMO login while popouts were open. This is **game-side visual evidence**, not proof our Companion causes it. Do not modify PokeMMO client/theme, but collect logs and ask user only if it blocks further QA.

## Foundation and integrated feature implementation
After P0 is corrected, create versioned, migration-tested **shared local data contracts** for ItemCatalog, global Notes, individual Pokémon instances, Guide definitions and media references; keep existing per-species Notes and manual Pokédex registry separately. There is no request to wait and plan endlessly; implement a useful **end-to-end Notes UI** and/or **Item Library** within v0.1.0 if reliable without risking accuracy. Ship robust UI not inert buttons.
- Item importer: the user's current PokeMMO dump has 3,006 item records and 2,366 PNG icons; current importer extracts only breeding icons. Extend full local icon extraction safely, de-dup IDs, missing icon fallback, search/detail, no raw assets to GitHub.
- Notes: full create/edit/delete/archive/search/tag and a resizable translucent note popout, with entity links.
- Later: curated Box with optional IV/EV/nature/moves/capture count, Showcase overlays from selected instances, custom Guides and interactive map connections, all per roadmap; avoid claiming these already exist.
- User wants toolbar EN/ES/Chinese beta quick toggle, expanded settings and per-tool customization. Use translation architecture with English fallback; only call translated content accurate if checked.
